state:
**Goal `ext-grants` — a guest reaches only the files and hosts all three parties grant — Stage 3 (the grant) is written; Stage 4 (files) is next.** M9. No floor is carried: the suites, the `.nvst` trees and `nv verify` are the safety net, and goals `ext-host` and `ext-compiler`'s tests stay green as tests of the tree.

The design is ADR 0246 § 7 and the user's, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No record slot: a question the record leaves is settled under AGENTS.md's priority ordering and written in the module doc of the file that answers it.

**On disk:** `nvs_ext::wasi` links the world's WASI but `wasi:http`, with an empty context; `nvs_ext::world` links `nvs:ext/log` and `nvs:ext/settings`. `[[extension]] grants` is `nvs_config::tree::Grants`, and `nvs_config::extension::grants` returns `Granted` with absolute roots. `nvs_ext::grants::effective` (behind `engine`) intersects `Granted`, the manifest's `Requests` and a `Caller` (the snapshot's `Capabilities` plus an isolate's `grants:` list) into `Effective`, canonicalising entry roots through `nvs_config::capability::resolved`; its module doc owns the semantics (manifest lists request a kind; the caller narrows by path; a write root needs `fs.write` and `fs.read`). `Capabilities::holds` exposes a cap's `Grant` for it. Tests: `crates/nvs-ext/tests/grants.rs`.

**Still open:** nothing calls `effective` yet, so no guest holds a preopen or a host. Monotonic subscriptions are `Ready` at once.

next.title: files
next.note: one file set: `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs`, `crates/nvs-ext/src/grants.rs`, and a new `crates/nvs-ext/tests/files.rs`.

items.text: **Preopens per instance** — when `crates/nvs-ext/src/call.rs:778` (`instantiate`) builds the store, it asks `crates/nvs-ext/src/grants.rs:95` (`effective`) for the instance's set and preopens each `read` root read-only and each `write` root read-write under its canonical path, linked by `crates/nvs-ext/src/wasi.rs:166`. The `Caller` comes from the request's snapshot and `Ctx::grant_filter` (`crates/nvs-runtime/src/ctx/isolate.rs:739`), passed in through `Budget` or `At`. `rule:security/extension-grants-are-an-intersection`.

**A guest path stays under its root** — tests in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/files.rs` that `..` past a root and a planted symlink both fail, a read outside fails for each party, a read inside all three succeeds, and a write to a read-only root fails (goal § Stage 4). The test `Budget` to copy is `crates/nvs-ext/tests/wasi.rs:329`. `rule:security/path-scope-canonicalise-then-prefix`.

backlog: A manifest `connect` entry meaning any host (`"any"` in the goal prose) is not supported; add it only if a first-party component needs it (`crates/nvs-ext/src/grants.rs` module doc).
`nvs ext inspect` printing a manifest's requests is goal `ext-tooling`'s.
